title: Bound the stopped-recursion cost coefficient by 1,209,000 (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove a smaller sufficient constant for PR4965's stopped mixed complex recursion, under the same critical moment, node, child-volume, leaf and placement premises. Claim type: scoped all-size written proof with exact finite corroboration. No new κ or selected-frontier change.

```text
critical width potential -> substochastic child weights
strict width contraction -> bounded backward path toll
lower-order node exponent -> coefficient below 1,209,000
```

The complete layer bound is

```text
V Lambda h^(1-q) [1,209,000(c_N+c_L)+73^b c_L+2c_P].
```

PR4965 reports its adapter/remainder coefficient above 7e27. The new rational coefficient is `73/[25(a2-b)] < 1,209,000`; leaf and placement terms stay the same. This improves a theoretical sufficient cost constant, without changing an exponent or claiming a runtime gain. The source's critical moment inequality is cited, not recomputed.

Credit JoyboyBrian / PR4965 for the recurrence and previous bound; Cinna Davis / PR4100 and PR4088 for the mixed construction and histogram; Jose Manuel / PR4178, Matarener / PR4424, unpaidmoon / PR4375 and the retained native/compiler/outer lineage. Weighted path probabilities, geometric series and concavity are classical. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas.

## Evidence

Before: the cited proof uses `1/(1-mu_tau)` near its critical exponent. After: PROOF.md bounds each normalized path by `s^(-delta)/(1-rho^delta)`, then uses rational concavity with `delta=a2-b` and `rho=48/73`.

Local CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64 passed:

- 1,536 new floor-recursion cases, checked by literal expansion and a separate bottom-up recurrence; 38,296 visited nodes.
- 96 rational-square trees with exact half-integer powers; 1,352 visited nodes.
- Eleven invalid-premise and failure controls; exact coefficient, remainder absorption and outer exponent comparisons.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized registered checks, individually timed at 0.25 seconds each. No timing improvement is claimed.
- Metadata/source pins, committed bytes, owner-execute modes and source history; official export integrity; read-only Git-free normal/optimized replay with empty PATH. All seven exported files retained their hashes and modes.

From the worktree root, reproduce with the exact local interpreter path, or substitute another CPython 3.12 installation:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/stopped-tree-contraction-constant/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/stopped-tree-contraction-constant/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/stopped-tree-contraction-constant
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/stopped-tree-contraction-constant --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected markers: `PASS_STOPPED_TREE_CONTRACTION_CONSTANT`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`, `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The standalone verifier prints a generated receipt bound to all six package-file hashes and writes nothing. No predecessor scientific verifier or instance was replayed.

## Limitations

The universal statement rests on the written proof. Finite trees corroborate their declared domains. The critical moment inequality and physical N/L/P/A premises remain dependencies. Complete child realization, local suspension, native/all-column operators, dirty restoration, compiler closure, storage, precision/tape and analytic recovery are not established. This is not an optimal constant, actual finite-cutoff reduction, physical supplier or complete multiplication theorem. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker and the selected cold replay were not run.

## Open next questions

Can the smaller analytical coefficient reduce an actual physical supplier's finite cutoff? First supply numerical node, leaf and placement constants and one realized whole-child interface, then compare complete cutoff inequalities. Unknown suspension and implementation costs block that operational claim.

## Related open work

No open PR found in the refreshed complete open-PR snapshot and targeted live searches studies this fixed stopped mixed-recursion coefficient. PR4965 and the different selected-uniform recurrence specialization PR6115 are merged predecessors/context; this does not audit either result. Sparse local notes and unpublished work remain overlap limits.

The completion refresh inspected the twelve other open PRs this account created since the advance CLAIM. They concern characteristic-five and nilpotent-Schur replays, dyadic balancing and capacities, an elementary matcher, observable-mask preparation, tensor reconstruction, a ternary COPY floor, a Gaussian inverse bound, rank-exchange credit and alternating label widths. None studies this fixed stopped-recursion coefficient or reports a competing value computed here. No extra computations were run to check another contribution.

The completed checks were read once; run metadata confirms success and the matching head. Hosted replay certifies execution of the registered normal and optimized finite checks, not independent mathematical or proof-kernel acceptance of the universal written proof. All local checks listed above passed.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Adds one six-file research package with no shared-code or selected-record changes.
